text:
ops-oncall: FYI - starting to investigate APAC cluster. ~60 pods pending that need GPUs, but nodes report 0 allocatable GPUs. New nodes coming up also show 0 devices.
kenji: checking nvidia-driver DaemonSet history now.
kenji: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout history ds/nvidia-driver-ds` -> revisions 4..7, latest image tag sha-2026-03-17.
amanda: saw this earlier on a single host, kernel log shows device unregisters. dumping snippet: ```Mar 17 12:04:21 node-az1 kernel: nvidia: unregistering device 0000:65:00.0 (GPU disappeared)
Mar 17 12:04:21 node-az1 kubelet[1234]: device plugin: device list changed, 0 GPUs available```
leo: autoscaler started provisioning replacements which immediately register with 0 GPUs -> scaling loop. infra-bot alarm fired IT-APAC-GPU-UTIL.
infra-bot: alert: cluster-autoscaler upscaling apac-gpu-pool from 8 -> 32 due to unschedulable pods (policy: cpu/gpu-pressure).
miguel: rolling back driver image to previous stable tag (sha-2026-02-10) on a single canary node to validate. Patching daemonset now.
ops-oncall: can we prevent autoscaler from adding more broken nodes? suggestion: taint the GPU nodegroup to NoSchedule until we confirm fix.
leo: applying quick taint to new nodegroup in APAC: `kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=apac-gpu gpu=broken:NoSchedule` - done for nodes matching apac-gpu-*.
kenji: can we drain a few broken nodes and force reboot to clear device state?
amanda: one repro step: nvidia driver v515 -> device lost after init on certain kernel combo. reboot sometimes clears but patch is better.
miguel: rolled daemonset to stable tag on canary, can confirm GPU shows allocatable=1 on canary node. Plan to roll to remainder after canary looks good (5m watch).
ops-oncall: opened cloud support ticket to temporarily raise instance quota for APAC in case we need capacity fallback. ticket# CS-68192.
sre-bot: NOTE: status page update pending — staging message drafted. @ops-oncall please push if we hit customer impact.
kenji: once drivers rolled, will remove taint and cordon->drain any nodes that remain bad. autoscaler should stop once pods schedule on fixed nodes.
leo: running `kubectl get nodes -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,GPUs:.status.allocatable.nvidia.com/gpu` -> shows canary node with GPUs=1, others 0.
ops-oncall: current mitigation summary: 1) tainted new GPU nodegroup to stop scaling, 2) canary rollback of driver succeeded, 3) draining and reboot plan for effected nodes, 4) opened quota ticket. monitoring dashboards set to 1m.
amanda: follow-up: create CI gate to run a quick device smoke test after driver rollouts (short script in ds post-start). Filing a short RFC.
miguel: rolling to remainder now. will post final when complete.
ops-oncall: thanks all — keeping thread open until autoscaler steady and pending queue < 5. will post TL;DR after closure. :white_check_mark:
